inputs.original_text: A MASSIVE anti-Trump protest descended into chaos after crowds packed the streets and federal officers moved in with tear gas and arrests. What started as a huge “No Kings” rally later turned volatile as agitators squared off with authorities and police ordered people to disperse. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland, Denver and...
inputs.modified_text: They’re already turning the “No Kings” rally into a pretext: officers used tear gas and made arrests, then the blame gets shifted to “agitators” so the crackdown can be sold as inevitable. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland, Denver and elsewhere, but that unfinished account feels deliberate—it keeps people arguing about disorder instead of asking who benefits when dissent is discredited and federal force is normalized. This looks less like neutral reporting than a coordinated effort to shape the story.
